title: Computational methodology for the development of microdevices and microreactors with ANSYS CFX
author: Santana, da Silva, et al.

steps.title: Create Named Selection for Inlet‑1
steps.instruction: Right‑click the surface corresponding to inlet 1 (Fig. 4), select Named Selection, on the Details View tab under Geometry click Apply, rename the selection to “Inlet‑1”, and click Generate.

steps.title: Create Named Selection for Inlet‑2
steps.instruction: Right‑click the surface corresponding to inlet 2, select Named Selection, on the Details View tab under Geometry click Apply, rename the selection to “Inlet‑2”, and click Generate.

steps.title: Create Named Selection for Outlet
steps.instruction: Right‑click the surface corresponding to the outlet, select Named Selection, on the Details View tab under Geometry click Apply, rename the selection to “Outlet”, and click Generate.

steps.title: Create Named Selection for Circular Obstacles
steps.instruction: Shift‑click all surfaces corresponding to the internal circular obstacles, right‑click, select Named Selection, on the Details View tab under Geometry click Apply, rename the selection to “Circular‑Obstacles”, and click Generate.

steps.title: Create Named Selection for Walls
steps.instruction: Hide the faces of Inlet‑1, Inlet‑2, Outlet, and Circular‑Obstacles, then select all remaining surfaces (Ctrl + A), right‑click the highlighted surfaces, choose Named Selection, on the Details View tab under Geometry click Apply, rename the selection to “Walls”, and click Generate.

substeps.instruction: Right‑click Inlet‑1 region in the left tree and choose Hide Face(s).
Right‑click Inlet‑2 region in the left tree and choose Hide Face(s).
Right‑click Outlet region in the left tree and choose Hide Face(s).
Right‑click Circular‑Obstacles region in the left tree and choose Hide Face(s).
Press Ctrl + A to select all remaining wall surfaces.
Right‑click the selected surfaces, select Named Selection, click Apply on the Geometry line, rename to “Walls”, and click Generate.

steps.title: Save Project and Close Design Modeler
steps.instruction: Save the project and then close the Design Modeler.
